bio.text: Lisa Dunkley is a Democratic member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 97, elected in 2022.
According to the House's biographical page, Dunkley is a retired U.S. Army veteran and consultant who lives in Sunrise and holds a B.B.A. from Florida Atlantic University.
Dunkley was born in Kingston, Jamaica, and moved to Florida in 1995.
